correctness.rationale: An actual 219x219 integral unit minor of Gamma d3 is recomputed from 219 distinct admissible 3-cubes. Its column span is saturated in C2; rank of ker d2 is 219 by a mod-two rank-nine lower bound and the d1 upper bound. Thus integral H2 Gamma vanishes. Complete two-section cubical cone proves Box and times vanish; the signed tetrahedral boundary is a primitive embedded H2 generator.
